cause_arm_audit.runtime_overdue: Update-related runtime departure after no-progress deadline; source _overdue_cause_sentence verifies bound is no movement, not time since last update.
cause_arm_audit.runtime_update_failed: Update incomplete; loaded version retained. Clearly distinct from runtime leaving for update.

cause_arm_audit.owner_lost: Runtime stopped answering during turn; no invented process death.
